brief.users: Quality Engineers in the Manufacturing sector (beginner data literacy)
brief.constraints: Data refreshes monthly; respect WCAG AA accessibility.

context_summary.audience: Quality Engineers in the Manufacturing sector (beginner data literacy)

layout.pattern: Headline KPI strip on top; supporting charts ordered by importance.
layout.primary_section: Headline metrics for Defect Rate and Overall Equipment Effectiveness
layout.secondary_section: Trend and comparison charts for the remaining KPIs

styling.number_format: percentages to 1 decimal; large values with K/M suffix
styling.accessibility: maintain >= 4.5:1 contrast; never rely on color alone

rationales.claim: Use a bar chart for Defect Rate.
rationales.principle: Bar length supports precise magnitude comparison across discrete categories.

rationales.claim: Use a bar chart for Overall Equipment Effectiveness.
rationales.principle: Bar length supports precise magnitude comparison across discrete categories.

rationales.claim: Use a bar chart for Yield by Line.
rationales.principle: Bars baselined at zero make positive/negative deviations explicit.

rationales.claim: Limit each view to 5-7 elements and group related KPIs.
rationales.principle: Managing cognitive load keeps the dashboard scannable (Few 2006).
